document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
A once popular novel, one eerie sequence tells of deadly creatures 
pursuing the hero down strangely-twisting corridors. He protects 
himself against the creatures, which are not of this Earth, by 
touching a magic amulet and receiving help from a god called 
only the “Ancient Master.” 
Return to 275.
(275)
